verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's in-product AI, Ari, answers questions about your financial data, such as why spending went up or how long cash lasts. It builds a checkable Model from your connected data and proactively messages you when something changes, which delivers AI-generated insights inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs), and explicit documentation of Ari making proactive recommendations or suggestions rather than answering questions and flagging changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask it whether you can afford to hire, why spending went up, or how long your cash lasts.
Ari builds the model and keeps it current, then messages you when something moves rather than waiting to be asked.
Ari connects to your ledger, bank and payroll, keeps one model of the company current, and tells you what changed before you ask.
Ari answers by building and updating a financial Model of your business, and you can open that Model, check every number, and change the assumptions yourself.
